label: Fleet Ingestion Pipeline (AWS)
info: AWS-deployed variant of the ingestion pipeline. Identical filtering/aggregation/transformation logic to flows.json, but publishes to each microservice's own SQS queue (the 'Event Router / Queue' in Figure 1) instead of calling the services over HTTP - this is what makes the downstream microservices genuinely event-driven rather than RPC targets.

name: Malformed payload rejection
Static-state + threshold filter
Format transform (GeoJSON)
Temporal aggregation (rolling avg speed)
Spatial aggregation (geohash zone)
Event flagging
Event Router -> SQS
info: Publishes to the correct per-microservice SQS queue via the AWS SDK client injected in settings.js functionGlobalContext. See node-red/settings.js.
